reviews.comment: Great professor. Cares very deeply about the subject and students. Very little in the way of homework outside of readings. The class is easy if you keep up with the readings. Very knowledgeable and puts in effort to make the class as good as possible. He is also very patient with questions and grades somewhat leniently.
Great prof. Helps so much and learned a lot. Make sure to read. Must actually do work and know what the material is to pass this class.

reviews.comment: Very good professor over all; easy to talk to, lenient on grading, and has very active and student-involved lectures. There's no homework for this class besides readings (although there's a fair amount), 1 or 2 short papers, and a solo project. Was willing to listen and actually implement ideas we had about the coursework (change deadlines, etc)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a new professor so things aren't perfect, but overall a great speaker/lecturer and the class is interesting if  put in the effort. Pop quizzes but lenient grading. There is a fair amount of reading, but it's manageable if you put in the work. This is not a "blow-off" class. Office hours are helpful and he's cool to just talk to.
